 x=[7]
 def read(): return x
 def write(value):
  nonlocal x
  x=value
 return read,write

c=f.__closure__[0]
print(c is g.__closure__[0])
c.cell_contents=[9]
print(f()[0])
g([11])

del c.cell_contents
try: f()
except NameError: print("empty")

except ValueError: print("read empty")

c.cell_contents=[13]
print(f()[0])
